flashcards.q: How is nurture used in AI Marketing Automation Integration?
flashcards.a: This chapter teaches you how to connect AI to the systems a business already uses to attract, nurture and convert buyers: email platforms, advertising accounts, websites, forms and the customer relationship management system, or CRM.

flashcards.q: How should buying journey not be handled in AI Marketing Automation Integration?
flashcards.a: Automation should move people through a buying journey, not just send them emails.

flashcards.q: What does AI Marketing Automation Integration teach about deliverability rules?
flashcards.a: You will learn to design lifecycle stages and a sales handoff, build and calibrate a lead score, add AI steps to a workflow safely, keep every message within consent and deliverability rules, and prove with a control group what the automation actually adds.

flashcards.q: What should be avoided with badly in AI Marketing Automation Integration?
flashcards.a: Neither is worth much if the systems underneath are badly connected, so the chapter spends as much time on integration, data flow and measurement as it does on the AI itself.

flashcards.q: When is send-time applied in AI Marketing Automation Integration?
flashcards.a: Add AI-generated content, send-time choices and next-best-action steps to a workflow with guardrails, review sampling and a cost estimate.

flashcards.q: When should moves not be used in AI Marketing Automation Integration?
flashcards.a: A stage that no rule moves people out of becomes a graveyard.

flashcards.q: Where does king Academy come up in AI Marketing Automation Integration?
flashcards.a: The chapter closes with a field case from the Sales King Academy platform and a lab you complete in its live Automations hub and CRM.

flashcards.q: Where does enough not apply in AI Marketing Automation Integration?
flashcards.a: - **Enough history.** The model needs hundreds of past conversions, not dozens, and the history must reflect today's market and offer.

flashcards.q: Is probably always required in AI Marketing Automation Integration?
flashcards.a: The workflow very probably helps, but its true effect could be much smaller or much larger than the 0.8-point estimate.

flashcards.q: Which approach to adds judgment fits AI Marketing Automation Integration?
flashcards.a: AI adds judgment to those rules: it can rank leads, choose content, pick a send time and draft copy.

flashcards.q: Which uses of picklist should be ruled out in AI Marketing Automation Integration?
flashcards.a: A new option added to a picklist in the CRM, with no matching option in the automation platform, can cause every record with that value to stop syncing, and nobody notices until a campaign reaches far fewer people than expected.

flashcards.q: Who is involved with nurture in AI Marketing Automation Integration?
flashcards.a: This chapter teaches you how to connect AI to the systems a business already uses to attract, nurture and convert buyers: email platforms, advertising accounts, websites, forms and the customer relationship management system, or CRM.

flashcards.q: Who should not be handling nobody in AI Marketing Automation Integration?
flashcards.a: Nobody on the marketing team presses send on those emails.

flashcards.q: Why does attribution matter in AI Marketing Automation Integration?
flashcards.a: Compare attribution models, calculate credit under each, and explain why attribution and incrementality answer different questions.

flashcards.q: Why is asked not always the right choice in AI Marketing Automation Integration?
flashcards.a: The example shows why a score should guide attention, not override a buyer who has directly asked to talk.

flashcards.q: How is data moves used in AI Marketing Automation Integration?
flashcards.a: Map how data moves between a CRM, a marketing automation platform, a website, ad platforms and analytics, and name the integration methods used to connect them.

flashcards.q: How should pricing page not be handled in AI Marketing Automation Integration?
flashcards.a: And attribution measures association, not cause: a touch that every buyer happens to pass through, such as the pricing page, collects credit whether or not it changed anyone's mind.

flashcards.q: What does AI Marketing Automation Integration teach about triggers conditions?
flashcards.a: Explain the parts of a marketing automation system (triggers, conditions, actions, workflows) and what AI adds to each.

flashcards.q: What should be avoided with carries in AI Marketing Automation Integration?
flashcards.a: Marketing automation is software that carries out marketing tasks without a person starting each one.

flashcards.q: When is newsletter applied in AI Marketing Automation Integration?
flashcards.a: The classic example is a welcome series: someone signs up for a newsletter, and over the next two weeks they receive four emails that introduce the business, point to useful material and invite them to take a next step.

flashcards.q: When should nurture not be used in AI Marketing Automation Integration?
flashcards.a: When sales recycles a lead, the workflow returns it to a nurture track suited to the stated reason ("no budget until next quarter" leads to a different track from "wrong person, try the operations manager").

flashcards.q: Where does lifecycle stage come up in AI Marketing Automation Integration?
flashcards.a: | Data | System of record | |---|---| | Contact identity, owner, lifecycle stage | CRM | | Email consent and unsubscribe status | Marketing automation platform (synced to CRM immediately) | | Deals, amounts, close dates | CRM | | Payments, refunds, subscriptions | Billing system | | Ad spend and impressions | Ad platform |

flashcards.q: Where does audit found not apply in AI Marketing Automation Integration?
flashcards.a: **Leaking internal numbers.** The same audit found that internal chain numbers, which link records inside the platform and have no meaning or use for users, were appearing in responses from the platform's interface and on screens.

flashcards.q: Is percent confidence always required in AI Marketing Automation Integration?
flashcards.a: The difference was only just significant, and the 95 percent confidence interval for the uplift ran from about 0.11 to 1.49 percentage points, so the true effect could be much smaller or larger.

flashcards.q: Which approach to half value fits AI Marketing Automation Integration?
flashcards.a: She attended a webinar 40 days ago, which counts at half value: 15 × 0.5 = 7.5.

flashcards.q: Which uses of choosing should be ruled out in AI Marketing Automation Integration?
flashcards.a: Most marketing automation (choosing which email to send) does not reach that level, but automation that decides credit terms, eligibility or pricing for individuals can, and needs careful review.

flashcards.q: Who is involved with attended in AI Marketing Automation Integration?
flashcards.a: A rule that says "send the pricing email three days after the webinar" treats a person who attended for five minutes the same as one who stayed for the full hour and asked two questions.

flashcards.q: Who should not be handling retried in AI Marketing Automation Integration?
flashcards.a: The same rule protects money: an action that charges a customer or issues a refund must never be blindly retried.

flashcards.q: Why does sync matter in AI Marketing Automation Integration?
flashcards.a: **Error queues and alerts.** Records that fail to sync should land somewhere a person can see them, with the reason, rather than disappearing.

flashcards.q: Why is suppression checks not always the right choice in AI Marketing Automation Integration?
flashcards.a: Look for overlaps that send the same person too many messages, workflows whose goal no longer matters, branches no one ever reaches, and consent or suppression checks that were missed.
